data.statement: Replace AI Translation report/state persistence with one strict authoritative translated_text.json document; preserve chunk-level resume, current-profile budgeting, minimal response validation, debounced review edits, non-destructive retranslation, existing broad downstream reset policy, and approved-translation downstream gating; provide no migration or compatibility for prior translation artifacts.

acceptance: Only translated_text.json is authoritative; legacy report/state are neither produced nor consumed; strict incompatible data is rejected without overwrite; count/status summaries are derived; resume preserves completed chunks and uses the current profile; review writes are debounced/single-write; failed or cancelled retranslation preserves old text; approved translation remains the downstream gate; focused tests and workflow audits pass.
open_questions: Approve intentional incompatibility with existing AI Translation artifacts and no migration?
data.reason: Project policy requires a human risk checkpoint for an intentionally incompatible persistence replacement; the user has already supplied explicit approval and instructed automatic continuation through delivery.
recommended_responses: Approved: replace the old contract without migration and require Reset Translation for incompatible data.
scope: In scope: AI Translation service/state/controller/page, prompt simplification, strict monofile loading/writing, current-profile resume, cancellation/failure, debounced manual edits, non-destructive selected retranslation, manifest summary ownership, direct downstream consumers, focused tests, durable requirements, and component documentation. Out of scope: SQL, migration or legacy compatibility, semantic translation scoring, per-segment checkpoints, chunk-scoped downstream invalidation, full application regression, publishing, push, or PR.
data.source: User-provided AI Translation monofile replacement plan and explicit instruction to continue through delivery
data.understanding: Replace the current three-file AI Translation persistence contract with one strict authoritative translated_text.json document containing target language, operation status, token usage, current-run budget metadata, general operator instructions, and minimal chunk review records. Remove report/state compatibility and migration; resume by canonical source order at the first empty translation; use the currently selected profile budget; preserve completed chunks, minimal JSON response validation, manual review, same-language LLM use, broad downstream reset policy, and approved-only downstream consumption.
